name: manyhands
description: Problem-first coordination for ambitious open-source software.

scripts.format: prettier --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.tests.json eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs playwright.config.ts vitest.config.ts .github/dependabot.yml .github/workflows/application-ci.yml .github/workflows/database-ci.yml .github/workflows/repository-health.yml apps/web packages tests
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.tests.json eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs playwright.config.ts vitest.config.ts .github/dependabot.yml .github/workflows/application-ci.yml .github/workflows/database-ci.yml .github/workflows/repository-health.yml apps/web packages tests
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/domain/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.db:lint: supabase db lint --local --schema public,private --level warning --fail-on warning
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
